provenance: Explicit (non-derived) sign tables from docs/design/readout-and-plasticity-options.md, 'Readout options'. The CIRCUIT tables are NOT stored here: they are derived from mbon_dopamine_input.json by the dominant-family rule at a chosen threshold (see readout.circuit_sign_table).
sign_convention: +1 = approach-like MBON, -1 = avoidance-like MBON, 0 (or absent) = zero readout weight. Keys are FlyWire cell_type labels (e.g. 'MBON05'), not root IDs.

strict.description: Individually, confidently labelled types only (activation-valence table). Avoidance: MBON05, MBON21. Approach: MBON11, MBON12.

group.description: STRICT plus an explicit MODELLING ASSUMPTION that group-level labels hold per type: glutamatergic MBON01/03/04 avoidance; MBON08/09 and MBON15-19 approach. All other labels zero.
